facts: The Deluxe King Room features a king-sized bed, city view, 55-inch smart TV, and a marble en-suite bathroom with a rainfall shower.
Room size is 42 sqm. Maximum occupancy is 2 adults.
Includes complimentary minibar refresh once daily, Nespresso machine, and high-speed Wi-Fi.
The Deluxe Twin Room has two single beds, garden view, 55-inch smart TV, and a marble en-suite bathroom.
Room size is 40 sqm. Maximum occupancy is 2 adults.
Ideal for travelling colleagues or friends. Includes Nespresso machine and high-speed Wi-Fi.
The Junior Suite offers a separate living area with a sofa, king-sized bed, panoramic city view, and a luxury bathroom with a deep-soaking tub and separate rainfall shower.
Room size is 68 sqm. Maximum occupancy is 2 adults.
Includes premium minibar, Nespresso machine, complimentary pressing of 2 garments per day, and butler service on request.
The Presidential Suite spans 180 sqm across two floors with a private terrace, panoramic views, a grand living room, dining area for 8, and two king bedrooms.
Includes a private butler, dedicated check-in, complimentary airport transfers, daily fruit basket, and access to the Executive Lounge.
Maximum occupancy is 4 adults. Available on request — please contact the front desk to arrange.
All rooms include: high-speed Wi-Fi, 55-inch smart TV, in-room safe, minibar, Nespresso machine, electric kettle, iron and ironing board, hairdryer, and premium Molton Brown toiletries.
Rooms are serviced daily between 9 AM and 12 PM. Turn-down service is available on request.
Extra pillows, blankets, or a cot can be requested from housekeeping at any time.
Garden Cafe serves breakfast daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM.
The menu offers a full buffet with hot and cold options, fresh juices, pastries, eggs cooked to order, and a healthy corner.
Private dining and room service breakfast orders can be arranged by calling the concierge.
Sakura Japanese Restaurant is open for lunch (12 PM–3 PM) and dinner (6 PM–10:30 PM) daily.
The menu features authentic Japanese cuisine: sushi, sashimi, teppanyaki, ramen, and a curated sake and whisky selection.
Reservations are recommended for dinner. Contact the concierge or front desk to book a table.
Olive Terrace serves Mediterranean cuisine in an open-air terrace setting, open daily for lunch (12 PM–3 PM) and dinner (6:30 PM–11 PM).
Signature dishes include wood-fired sea bass, mezze platters, and house-made pasta.
Live music is featured every Friday and Saturday evening. Reservations recommended on weekends.
Room service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
The room service menu includes light bites, full meals, desserts, and beverages from all hotel restaurants.
Orders typically arrive within 30–45 minutes. Call the in-room dining extension or use the hotel app to order.
The hotel spa is open daily from 9 AM to 8 PM.
Services include Swedish and deep-tissue massage, hot stone therapy, aromatherapy, facials, body wraps, and couple's treatment suites.
Treatments range from 30 minutes to 3 hours. Advance booking is recommended — contact the concierge or front desk to reserve.
The rooftop infinity pool is open daily from 7 AM to 9 PM, weather permitting.
Poolside towels, loungers, and sunbeds are complimentary for hotel guests.
The pool bar serves drinks, juices, and light snacks from 10 AM to 8 PM.
The fitness centre on the 2nd floor is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and is accessible with your room key.
Equipment includes cardio machines, free weights, resistance machines, and a stretching area.
Personal training sessions and group classes (yoga, pilates, HIIT) can be arranged through the concierge.
The hotel has 3 fully equipped conference rooms accommodating 10 to 120 guests.
All rooms include AV equipment, high-speed Wi-Fi, whiteboards, and video conferencing facilities.
Catering packages, secretarial services, and dedicated event coordination are available.
To check availability and rates, please contact the front desk or the events team.
The business centre is located on the ground floor and is open from 7 AM to 9 PM daily.
Facilities include computers, high-speed printing, scanning, faxing, and courier services.
Private office pods are available for hourly rental — contact the front desk to arrange.
The concierge desk is staffed 24 hours a day and can assist with restaurant reservations, theatre tickets, sightseeing tours, and local recommendations.
Services include arranging private car hire, helicopter transfers, yacht charters, and bespoke city experiences.
Contact the concierge by phone, the hotel app, or by visiting the desk in the lobby.
A complimentary airport shuttle runs every 30 minutes between 5 AM and 11 PM.
Private car transfers can be arranged 24/7 at an additional cost — contact the concierge at least 2 hours in advance.
The drive to the main international airport takes approximately 35 minutes depending on traffic.
Laundry and dry-cleaning bags are available in your wardrobe.
Items dropped before 9 AM are returned the same day by 6 PM.
An express 4-hour laundry service is available at a premium — request via the hotel app or by calling housekeeping.
Complimentary luggage storage is available at the bell desk 24 hours a day.
The bell desk can also assist with delivering luggage to and from your room.
Oversized or sports equipment storage can be arranged — please contact the front desk.
Valet parking is available at $35 per night with unlimited in-and-out privileges.
Self-parking is available in the adjacent multi-storey car park at $20 per night.
Electric vehicle charging bays are available in the self-park facility — subject to availability.
The hotel is pet-friendly and welcomes dogs and cats.
A one-time pet fee of $75 applies per stay. Please inform the front desk of your pet at check-in.
Pet amenities including a bed, food bowls, and welcome treats are provided on request.
Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.
Network name: Hotel-Guest. The password is printed on your room key sleeve and available from the front desk.
A premium high-bandwidth connection is available for guests requiring video conferencing or large file transfers — ask the front desk.
Standard check-in time is 3 PM and check-out is 11 AM.
Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and may incur an additional charge — please request at the front desk.
Digital self check-in is available via the hotel app from 10 AM on your arrival day.
The hotel is entirely non-smoking indoors including all rooms, restaurants, and public areas.
A designated outdoor smoking area is located near the pool deck on the 3rd floor.
Smoking in a guest room will result in a deep-cleaning fee of $250.
The hotel has fully accessible rooms with roll-in showers, grab rails, and lowered wardrobes — available on request.
All public areas, restaurants, and the spa are wheelchair accessible via lifts and ramps.
Hearing loop systems are available in all conference rooms. Please advise the front desk of any accessibility requirements at booking.
The hotel concierge can arrange guided city tours, museum visits, and cultural experiences tailored to your interests.
Popular nearby attractions include the National Museum (10 min by car), the Old Town shopping district (15 min walk), and the Botanical Gardens (5 min by taxi).
The concierge desk has maps, transport passes, and can book skip-the-line tickets for major attractions.
